rationale: Intersect remains a distinct Google-owned digital-power and data-center platform after the March 10, 2026 acquisition and IPX carve-out. Pantheon/PINT's direct co-investment exited Intersect at closing and retained exposure only to separate IPX. The research is sound, but the requested holding is no longer current and Intersect's current owner is a corporate rather than an infrastructure manager, so the canonical list action requires review.
recommendedChanges: Do not represent Pantheon/PINT as a current Intersect owner.
Record Pantheon/PINT as a former direct owner from 2025-09-22 through 2026-03-10 if Intersect is retained as realized infrastructure-manager history.
Treat Alphabet/Google as the sole current post-carve-out Intersect owner from 2026-03-10.
Keep IPX separate and route it through its own canonical list review.
unresolvedQuestions: Google acquisition subsidiary/holding chain is not publicly disclosed.
Pre-close owner percentages and founder/management rollover treatment are not publicly disclosed.
Pantheon vehicle legal name and percentage are not publicly disclosed.
Macquarie/SoftBank company-versus-project ownership boundary remains unresolved.
